summary: Batch existing work-wake message cache validation reads

schema.detail: No database, index, trigger or persisted representation changes.

rules.detail: Every historical work-wake attempt, lifecycle and eligibility rule is preserved.

compatibility.detail: The reconciler reads the existing message-cache version keys in groups of at most 128. Other readers retain the same point lookup. No cache lifetime, response, wire or client contract changes.

downtime.detail: Deployment follows the existing daemon rollout; restart duration has not been measured for this change.

manual.detail: No configuration or operational action is required by the source change.
